title: Al-Ghafur and Al-Ghaffar: The Quran’s Two Names for Forgiveness, and the Difference Between Them
excerpt: Al-Ghafur appears ninety-one times in the Quran. Al-Ghaffar appears five. Same root, different pattern — and the rarer name lands only where repetition is the point being made.
seo_title: Al-Ghafur and Al-Ghaffar: Two Names in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Ghafur appears 91 times in the Quran; Al-Ghaffar just 5. One root, two patterns. What the difference means and where each forgiveness name lands.
